campagne_recolte_prevue.name: campagne_recolte_prevue
campagne_recolte_prevue.value: "campagne"."fin_recolte_prevue" IS NULL OR "campagne"."debut_recolte_prevu" IS NULL OR "campagne"."fin_recolte_prevue" >= "campagne"."debut_recolte_prevu"

emplacement_places_de_gouttiere.name: emplacement_places_de_gouttiere
emplacement_places_de_gouttiere.value: ("emplacement"."sorte" = 'gouttiere') = ("emplacement"."nombre_places" IS NOT NULL) AND ("emplacement"."nombre_places" IS NULL OR "emplacement"."nombre_places" > 0)

espece_delais_retour.name: espece_delais_retour
espece_delais_retour.value:
("espece"."delai_retour_minimal_ans" IS NULL AND "espece"."delai_retour_conseille_ans" IS NULL)
        OR ("espece"."delai_retour_minimal_ans" >= 0 AND "espece"."delai_retour_conseille_ans" >= "espece"."delai_retour_minimal_ans")

evenement_detail_recolte.name: evenement_detail_recolte
evenement_detail_recolte.value:
"evenement"."type" <> 'recolte' OR ((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'quantite') = 'number' THEN ("evenement"."detail" -> 'quantite')::numeric > 0 ELSE false END)
        AND "evenement"."detail" ->> 'unite' IN ('kg', 'botte', 'piece', 'barquette')
        AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'categorie'), 'null') IN ('null', 'string')) IS TRUE

evenement_detail_realise.name: evenement_detail_realise
evenement_detail_realise.value:
"evenement"."type" <> 'realise' OR ("evenement"."detail" ->> 'etape' IN ('semis_pepiniere', 'semis_direct', 'plantation', 'arrachage')
        AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'quantiteReelle'), 'null') IN ('null', 'number')) IS TRUE

evenement_detail_intervention.name: evenement_detail_intervention
evenement_detail_intervention.value:
"evenement"."type" <> 'intervention' OR ("evenement"."detail" ->> 'categorie' IN ('travail_sol', 'couverture', 'fertilisation', 'amendement', 'entretien')
        AND jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'type') = 'string'
        AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'outil'), 'null') IN ('null', 'string')
        AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'dureeOccupationJours'), 'null') IN ('null', 'number')
        AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'quantite' -> 'valeur'), 'null') IN ('null', 'number')
        AND ("evenement"."detail" ->> 'categorie' NOT IN ('fertilisation', 'amendement')
          OR (jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'quantite' -> 'valeur') = 'number'
            AND jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'produit') = 'string'))) IS TRUE

evenement_detail_irrigation.name: evenement_detail_irrigation
evenement_detail_irrigation.value:
"evenement"."type" <> 'irrigation' OR (("evenement"."detail" ->> 'secteurIrrigationId') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
        AND (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'dureeMinutes') = 'number' THEN ("evenement"."detail" -> 'dureeMinutes')::numeric >= 0 ELSE false END)) IS TRUE

evenement_detail_traitement.name: evenement_detail_traitement
evenement_detail_traitement.value:
"evenement"."type" <> 'traitement' OR (("evenement"."detail" ->> 'produitPhytoId') ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
        AND est_date_calendaire("evenement"."detail" ->> 'recolteAutoriseeLe')
        AND (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'dose' -> 'valeur') = 'number' THEN ("evenement"."detail" -> 'dose' -> 'valeur')::numeric >= 0 ELSE false END)
        AND jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'dose' -> 'unite') = 'string'
        AND (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("evenement"."detail" -> 'surfaceTraiteeM2') = 'number' THEN ("evenement"."detail" -> 'surfaceTraiteeM2')::numeric >= 0 ELSE false END)) IS TRUE

occupation_place_positive.name: occupation_place_positive
occupation_place_positive.value: ("occupation"."longueur_m" IS NULL OR "occupation"."longueur_m" > 0) AND ("occupation"."nombre_places" IS NULL OR "occupation"."nombre_places" > 0)

occupation_periode_reelle.name: occupation_periode_reelle
occupation_periode_reelle.value: ("occupation"."reel_du" IS NOT NULL OR "occupation"."reel_au" IS NULL) AND ("occupation"."reel_au" IS NULL OR "occupation"."reel_au" >= "occupation"."reel_du")

serie_taille_positive.name: serie_taille_positive
serie_taille_positive.value: ("serie"."longueur_m" IS NULL OR "serie"."longueur_m" > 0) AND ("serie"."nombre_plants" IS NULL OR "serie"."nombre_plants" > 0)
